It reads below ~0.85 on nouns and names, on 'to/at/with/about' before a person or pronoun, on prepositions governed by the word before them ('interested in', 'trust in', 'depends on', 'rests on', 'theory of'), on commas in lists of names or abstract ideas, on German, and on sentence-final '.' outside instruction lists (~0.75); a text's first token alone reads 0.9-1.4 if it is 'The', 'Our', 'In', 'Then', 'Once', 'Please', a numeral, an imperative verb or a code keyword ('def', 'using', 'int'), but 0.5-0.85 for a pronoun, a name, 'A', 'An', 'My', 'His', 'This' or a quote mark.
